ranking_impact_summary: The candidate graph changes materially: Valtournenche becomes an independently rankable stay destination and weather owner with its own direct access and default local pass. The Italian connected domain preserves Cervinia-Valtournenche membership, but its unsupported 150 km, 22-lift, difficulty, and elevation metrics remain null and have no ranking influence. The cross-border 360 km/52-lift aggregate remains on the Matterhorn terrain domain, now with all three weather-owner members. Zermatt night skiing and Breuil-Cervinia base-local apres lose unsupported positive influence; Cervinia ski-day apres remains conservatively low-key. Pass expansion evaluates explicit Valtournenche-local, shared Italian, and international choices without treating duration/add-on variants as separate products.
unresolved_caveats: The new Valtournenche ski-area ID starts new weather/archive/climatology ownership; no existing cervinia-ski-area rows are migrated, renamed, or backfilled in this curation.
Chamois, Torgnon, Täsch, Randa, partial-area beginner products, and Aosta regional products remain in the canonical Matterhorn/Cervino backlog item for their stated graph or schema dependency.
The generic other-Aosta-area entitlement remains unnamed and unresolved; no artificial product or ski-area identity was created.

Official document inventory: matterhorn-2025-26-map is represented on terrain_domain:matterhorn-ski-paradise; deferred chamois-skirama and torgnon-skirama candidates are reconciled to their exact operator PDFs (https://cervinia-api.devtherocks.it/wp-content/uploads/2023/10/Chamois_IT_2014_2015.pdf and https://cervinia-api.devtherocks.it/wp-content/uploads/2021/11/SKIRAMA12_alta-TORGNON.pdf) without attributing either document to the active Cervinia-Valtournenche terrain domain.

Named duration/add-on children reviewed as non-separate include half-day, 6.5-day, 1/2+6+1/2-day, 1-21-day, monthly, consecutive/non-consecutive, 5-in-7/8-in-10/11-in-13 flex, 1/2/3-day extensions, daily Zermatt supplements, morning/afternoon, Quota 2500, beginner, playground, Desert, Freedom, and lift-only variants.

The Cervinia-Valtournenche connected-domain membership is retained, but the tariff does not support terrain metrics; 150 km, 22 lifts, the 54/87/9 km split, and 1524-3480 m bounds remain null pending direct owner-scoped evidence.
